description: Raise the luminance of an RGB view in place where Ha exceeds it, keeping colour ratios. With Y the Rec.709 luminance, each channel is multiplied by (Y + strength * max(Ha - Y, 0)) / Y. Runs as 64-bit PixelMath truncated to [0,1].

strength.description: Fraction of the Ha excess over the luminance that is added

target_id.description: Target RGB view, modified in place

name: ha_inject_luminance
